FAQ.title: Frequently asked questions
FAQ.subtitle: Answers to common questions about using Serrbi to post, discover, and manage work.

items.a: Serrbi is a marketplace for jobs, services, and tasks. Discover work, hire talent, and complete tasks in one place.

items.q: How do filters work on listing pages?
items.a: We apply your search term from links and cards as a query parameter (e.g. ?search=Dentist) so results are prefiltered when you arrive.

items.q: Can I post a job/service/task for free?
items.a: Yes. You can start on the Free plan which includes a limited number of listings. Upgrade anytime for higher limits and extra features.
Enable Auto‑Apply from your account and we’ll submit tailored applications each cycle using your preferences and uploaded resume.
